Advancing `account_002` from `active` to `at_risk` (the next lifecycle value), or advancing any existing opportunity/task, would have been me guessing at intent on records I can't un-modify. The playbooks are unrelated, and the reference tables contain only placeholder rows (company names with `active`/`inactive`/`pending` status and no rule text). So the field values above — naming convention, carrying over owner and revenue, the amount of 91.38 — are my reasonable inferences patterned on existing records, not values derived from a real standard.
